verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe several natural-language ways to operate the product. The official MCP server lets users read data and create and manage automations, sends and segments 'all through natural language prompts', with example prompts and separate read/write approvals. There is also a built-in agent that builds segments from plain-text descriptions, analyzes the workspace, runs scheduled tasks and takes requests in Slack. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that these natural-language operations work as claimed.
